skills.name: trip-planner
skills.description: Plans travel: day-by-day itineraries, what to see, and how to get around a destination.
skills.whenToUse: The user is going somewhere and wants help deciding what to do or see there.

skills.name: recipe-helper
skills.description: Suggests dishes and walks through cooking them from the ingredients the user has.
skills.whenToUse: The user wants to know what to cook or how to cook something.

skills.name: tax-questions
skills.description: Answers personal income tax questions: filing, deductions, and deadlines.
skills.whenToUse: The user asks about paying or filing their taxes.

opener.reply: Hi! What can I help you with today?

targeted.ask: I'm off to Lisbon for four days in May.
targeted.offer: Lovely time of year for it. I can put together a day-by-day plan for Lisbon: what to see each day and how to get between the sights. Want me to?

targeted.ask: All I've got in the cupboard is chickpeas, spinach and a tin of tomatoes.
targeted.offer: That's a good start. I can suggest a dinner you could make from exactly those and walk you through cooking it. Shall I?
